title: Breathe on Me, Breath of God
description: Breathe on Me, Breath of God in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 3 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Edwin Hatch, first published in 1878. The tune, AYLESBURY, is from John Chetham's Psalmody, 1718. This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: Breathe on me, breath of God, Fill me with life a-new, That I may love what Thou dost love, And do what Thou wouldst do.

lines: Breathe on me, breath of God,
That I may love what Thou dost love,
And do what Thou wouldst do.
Breathe on me, breath of God,
Until with Thee I will one will,
Breathe on me, breath of God,
But live with Thee the perfect life
